summary: Process/science separation, the internal conditional claim lane, exact baseline-plus-400 caveats, finite-ensemble terminal routing, and forbidden-promotion firewalls pass. One P1 remains: pr177_mask_control.json, pr177_mc_resolution.json, and pr177_artifact_manifest.json each emit the closed NO_RESOLVED_COUPLING_AT_CURRENT_MC_RESOLUTION scientific result but omit the strict 40 < L < 763 (integer 41..762) analysis support. A config hash supplies provenance but is not a self-contained claim boundary.

claim_findings.title: Three result-bearing artifacts omit the preregistered strict multipole support
claim_findings.statement: The frozen claim is defined only on strict 40 < L < 763, equivalently integer L=41..762. The main modulation result, input-authority receipt, and result card carry that support explicitly. The mask-control result, MC-resolution result, and artifact manifest instead carry scientific_result=NO_RESOLVED_COUPLING_AT_CURRENT_MC_RESOLUTION and scientific_status=CLOSED without an analysis_support or support field. Their shared config_hash is auditable provenance, but a consumer can extract the scientific result without learning the estimator domain. This leaves a concrete route to overgeneralizing an in-band conditional null to other multipoles.

assumptions: Every result-bearing artifact that can expose a scientific_result must state the estimator domain needed to interpret that result.
A SHA-256 config binding is necessary provenance but does not replace readable scope metadata in the artifact that emits the claim.
claim_findings.reproduction_command: python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; ps=['docs/generated/pr177_act_modulation_result.json','docs/generated/pr177_mask_control.json','docs/generated/pr177_mc_resolution.json','docs/generated/pr177_result_card.json','docs/generated/pr177_artifact_manifest.json','docs/generated/pr177_input_authority_receipt.json']; [print(p, bool({'analysis_support','support'} & set(json.loads(Path(p).read_text()))), json.loads(Path(p).read_text()).get('scientific_result')) for p in ps]"
required_remediation: Regenerate pr177_mask_control.json, pr177_mc_resolution.json, and pr177_artifact_manifest.json with a canonical analysis_support object or equivalent support field containing inequality=40 < L < 763, integer_min=41, integer_max=762, integer_count=722, and endpoints_40_and_763_included=false.
Add a fail-closed validator and mutation that reject any PR-177 result-bearing artifact or manifest whose scientific_result is non-null but whose exact strict support is absent or drifted.
Run a fresh hash-bound claim review after regeneration; do not overwrite this FAIL envelope.

passed_checks.evidence: All six generated artifacts keep process_execution_status separate from scientific_result; the input-authority receipt has scientific_result=null, and result-bearing artifacts use a separately preregistered terminal. See pr177_input_authority_receipt.json:58-67, pr177_act_modulation_result.json:1300-1305 and 1382-1387, and pr177_result_card.json:36-37 and 75-81.

Every generated artifact has claim_tier=conditional, claim_level=C3, scientific_artifact_mode=standard_internal, public_use=false, and transfer_source=none; all required metadata listed by the spec is present.

All six generated artifacts repeat the caveat that ranks are conditional on the selected ACT DR6 baseline released reconstruction and exactly 400 released reconstructions; null_mock_status also states exactly_400 and conditional_exchangeability. See each artifact's caveats plus pr177_result_card.json:32-37 and 68-81.

The controlled rank is 102/401 with guard [0.16944885802620666, 0.3392793215249155], raw is 99/401 with guard [0.1922761398164394, 0.30148944621847334], and mask change is 398/401 with guard [0.9815548130650192, 1.0]. All are RESOLVED_ABOVE_ALPHA, the candidate-survival flag is false, and reason=controlled_rank_resolved_above_alpha, matching the frozen no-resolved route. See pr177_result_card.json:39-69 and pr177_mask_control.json:2.

A recursive review of every string-valued field found no affirmative raw-QE/RDN0, detection, statistical-isotropy, cosmological/primordial-anisotropy, causal-mask, transfer/native, geometry, or family claim. Occurrences are confined to negated caveats, forbidden-use lists, source filenames, and false/null metadata. The main result also sets physical_interpretation=not_evaluated and raw_qe_reproduced=false.

headline_qualification.assessment: NO_RESOLVED_COUPLING_AT_CURRENT_MC_RESOLUTION is consistent with the frozen terminal and the observed guard intervals when it is co-rendered with the exact ACT baseline, 400-release-simulation, strict-band, mask-control, and no-physical-interpretation qualifiers. It is not safe as standalone prose such as 'ACT found no coupling' and must not be used without those qualifiers. The missing strict-support metadata identified above prevents a full pass for three artifacts.

allowed_language.standalone_sentence: Within the ACT DR6 baseline released reconstructed-kappa map and exactly 400 corresponding released reconstructed simulations, on strict integer multipoles 41 <= L <= 762, the prospectively frozen five-component quadrupolar fractional-variance diagnostic showed no resolved upper-tail departure at the current finite-ensemble rank resolution.
allowed_language.required_followup_sentence: This is an internal release-simulation-conditional C3 result; joint exchangeability is assumed, the registered mask control is bounded, and no raw-QE, detection, isotropy, physical-anisotropy, transfer, native-solver, geometry, or family interpretation was evaluated.
allowed_language.machine_enum_policy: The enum NO_RESOLVED_COUPLING_AT_CURRENT_MC_RESOLUTION may remain the preregistered machine terminal only when consumers also render the exact strict support, baseline-plus-400 scope, conditional tier, mask/null/covariance status, caveats, and public_use=false.
